'''Cutlass Squadron''' was a [[TIE/ca Punisher/Legends|TIE Punisher]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a pilot operating under this squadron passed through an asteroid field, bypassing wreckage.
